name: 21418-imagechat-qwen25vl3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1. Single GPU -- a 3B model at bf16 is ~6 GB on an 80 GB card. Do not shard it.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16. Language model: 36 layers, 16 query heads over 2 KV heads, hidden 2048, intermediate 11008, vocab 151936. Vision tower: 32 layers, hidden 1280, patch_size 14, spatial_merge_size 2, out_hidden_size 2048. A 640x360 image is 1196 patches and 299 vision tokens, pixel_values [1196, 1176] float32.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 50 streams, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 3000 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: Single-turn chat: one 640x360 JPEG at the 360p preset and a short instruction per request, assembled roundrobin(text, image) so the instruction precedes the image. Prompt text is UNIFORM on [1, 128] tokens and output length UNIFORM on [1, 32], so the means are 64 and 16, not 128 and 32.
purpose: A 3B vision-language assistant answering short questions about a single photo, 50 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id`.
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is DROPPED by the flat parser, silently, and the
# engine then starts without the key. Environment variables cannot live here.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
enable-multimodal: true

enable-mixed-chunk: true
max-running-requests: 128
max-prefill-tokens: 65536

# Pinned, with headroom on purpose: the scheduler sizes its KV pool from FREE GPU MEMORY read at
# startup, and the tokenizer side allocates its own device memory after that reading is taken.
mem-fraction-static: 0.75
